newsitem.title: USA: NAL Financial faces purchaser class action.
newsitem.headline: NAL Financial faces purchaser class action.

text.p: Investors sued NAL Financial Group Inc for securities fraud and making false statements that inflated the price of the company's stock, plaintiffs' lawyers said Wednesday.

The complaint, filed as a class-action in U.S. District Court in Florida, also charges that NAL and President Robert Bartolini overstated NAL's earnings and misstated its credit loss reserves and underwriting guidelines.
The complaint, which seeks unspecified damages, charges that the price of NAL stock was artificially inflated by the misrepresentations.
The buyers, who bought stock between April 2, 1996, and April 2, 1997, are represented by the law firms fo Rabin & Peckel LLP and the law office of Leo W. Desmond.
Officials at NAL were not immediately available to comment. NAL Financial Group provides auto financing services.
